# Documentation Instructions

- Keep topic-specific documents in the structure shown in the project tree, including `docs/decisions/` and `docs/ai/`.
- Link to existing canonical records instead of maintaining duplicate copies under legacy filenames.
- When both a legacy root-level document and a structured document exist, preserve their content and link between them; do not silently rename or remove either.
- Continue following the general project documentation rules in [docs.instructions.md](./docs.instructions.md).
